link.note: Collateral at most; 'via Brewster' — affected by the probable Brewster disproof. Under Jacobus he is father of the Hannah who married Samuel Thompson.

summary: Harvard's first class (1642); Brookhaven's first minister; not an ancestor, and his kinship now hinges on the Brewster question.
bio: Graduated in Harvard's first class (1642). At Walberswick, Suffolk in 1649; minister of Alby and Thwaite, Norfolk; Cromwell sent him to Ireland in 1655 with Henry Cromwell. Brookhaven's first minister. Sources disagree whether he was born in America or Bristol. His father-in-law Roger Ludlow 'removed to Virginia in 1654' (actually visited his brother George there, then went to Ireland) — in-law only. Cannot qualify John for the Colonial Clergy society (collateral).
